note_en: 越…越… means "the more… the more…": 他跑得越快，观众的加油声就越大 "the faster he ran, the louder the crowd cheered." Where English uses comparatives (faster, louder) after "the," Chinese puts 越 before each adjective or verb, and 就 often links the second half.
